title: PI-Loc: span-annotated benchmark and explainability audit harness for prompt-injection guardrails
description: Code, benchmark manifest, generated benchmark, raw results, statistics and figures for the paper 'Do Prompt-Injection Detectors Look at the Injection? A Localization-Faithful Explainability Audit of Agent Guardrails'. Run run_all.sh to rebuild PI-Loc from pinned public datasets and reproduce every number and figure.

creators.name: Ameur, Yulliwas
